scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix frontend && node scripts/go.mjs mod download
scripts.test: node scripts/go.mjs test ./... && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: node scripts/go.mjs fmt-check && node scripts/go.mjs vet ./... && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: node scripts/go.mjs build-app && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.check: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
